# Scalar source-operation fixtures and coverage audit

`ort127_source_ops.bin` and `pinned_coverage_3615.json` are generated by
`tools/generate_source_op_audit.py`. The generator first audits the exact pinned
model and then uses official ONNX Runtime 1.27.0 CPUExecutionProvider with graph
optimization disabled and one thread.

Regeneration with ONNX Runtime 1.28.0 produced a byte-identical fixture payload;
1.27.0 remains the stable fixture authority.

The compact fixture covers the pinned dtype/shape families for INT64 and FLOAT
`Less`, the final INT64 broadcast `Add`, and all four embedding scale words for
scalar-parameter INT8 `DequantizeLinear`. The adjacent JSON records provenance
and payload layout.

The coverage JSON assigns every one of the 3,615 source nodes to exactly one
kernel/fusion owner and fails generation if a node is unclassified or any
category count changes.
